vsat.title: VSAT Field Installation & Coordination Project
vsat.subtitle: PT. Telnusa Intrakom · West Kalimantan
vsat.situation: VSAT installation field project with PT. Telnusa Intrakom, West Kalimantan, in a remote location with challenging team coordination.
vsat.task: Assist technical coordination of satellite antenna installation and ensure the project proceeds according to schedule.
vsat.action: Arranged daily installation schedules and equipment readiness checklists (antenna, LNB, modem, coaxial cables) before the team headed to remote West Kalimantan. Coordinated with field technicians and local contacts to anticipate access hurdles from weather and terrain. Accompanied technical team during VSAT antenna pointing/alignment, helping troubleshoot when initial signal didn't hit targets. Documented daily installation progress (field photos, obstacle logs, milestones) for daily evaluation reports to the central project manager.
vsat.result: VSAT installation was successfully completed on schedule despite initial weather delays, achieving final signal quality that met client specifications. Well-organized field documentation streamlined project handoff. From this experience, I learned to manage technical projects under time, access, and remote coordination constraints between field and central teams — skills highly relevant to cross-divisional engineering teamwork requiring tight research, hardware, and software coordination.

brin.title: REST API Integration for Kebun Raya Cibinong App
brin.subtitle: National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN)
brin.situation: Internship as an Android Developer Intern at BRIN, working in a 4-person team (1 frontend, 2 backend, 1 Android) developing the Kebun Raya Cibinong mobile app.
brin.task: Integrate REST APIs between the Android application and backend systems whose data formats were often inconsistent.
brin.action: Held technical discussion sessions with the backend team, compared API documentation with actual implementation, and created sample request/response documentation for the entire team.
brin.result: Integration ran smoothly, data miscommunication was minimized, and core application features were completed on deadline.
